verdict.rationale: Vanta ships its own AI Agent, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools; the axis applies. The evidence only documents Vanta acting as an MCP server (the Vanta MCP server and the Developer Docs MCP server) that external assistants like Claude and Cursor connect to. That server-side role does not show Vanta can consume third-party MCP servers, and nothing in the pack documents client-side MCP support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
